question: Can I buy the items on display at the stall right now?
answer: Yes! All pieces on our exhibition table are available for immediate purchase. You can pay via UPI, Cash, or Card right at the booth. If your preferred color or size is already sold out, we can 3D print a fresh one for you and deliver it to your home.

question: How do custom 3D print orders work?
answer: Found a 3D model on Thingiverse, Printables, or MakerWorld? Or need a personalized nameplate, photo lithophane, or prototype? Simply send us the link, image, or STL file on WhatsApp. We will inspect the model, advise on print settings, and give you an instant quote.

question: What colors and filament finishes are available?
answer: We stock over 20+ premium filament options: Silk Rainbow (color-shifting), Dual-Color Silk, Glow in the Dark, High-Shine Gold/Bronze, Matte Pastels, and durable PETG. Ask to see our physical filament swatches at the booth!

question: How durable are 3D printed items?
answer: Our prints are engineered with reinforced infill and tuned wall perimeters for everyday handling. Fidget clickers and articulated toys are built specifically to withstand repeated movement, and functional home decor pieces are sturdy and long-lasting.

question: How long do custom orders take to print and deliver?
answer: Most custom prints take 24 to 48 hours to print, clean, and quality-check. You can choose home delivery or arrange local pickup. During the exhibition weekend, we prioritize event orders!

question: How do I claim the exhibition special offer?
answer: Just tap the WhatsApp button on this site or mention to us at the stall that you scanned the QR code. You will automatically receive our exhibition discount on custom orders and bundle purchases.
